title: Preparation of cultured cells for transmission electron microscope
protocol: Pre-warm fixative solution to 37°C.
Remove no more than two dishes at a time from incubator and pour off media.
Add glutaraldehyde fixative solution. Leave 20 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse twice with PBS.
Add osmium tetroxide solution and incubate for 30 minutes.
Rinse once with PBS.
Put on 30% hexylene glycol with swirling, leave for 15 minutes.
Put on 50% hexylene glycol with swirling, leave for 15 minutes.
Put on 70% hexylene glycol with swirling, leave for 15 minutes.
Put on 90% hexylene glycol with swirling, leave for 15 minutes.
Wash with 100% hexylene glycol with swirling, three times, each for 10 minutes.
Combine resin and hexylene glycol at a ratio of 1:2, add to dish, mix on rotor for 2 hours.
Combine resin and hexylene glycol at a ratio of 2:1, add to dish, mix on rotor for 2 hours.
Replace with 100% resin and place on rotor to mix for 4-6 hours.
Replace with fresh 100% resin and mix as above.
Replace with 100% resin, adjust level to ~1-2 mm depth, and bake for 8-12 hours.
Break dish with hammer, peel dish pieces away from cast containing sample.
Bake epoxy cast for an additional 16-24 hours.
Cut small pieces from the epoxy cast making note of the side with the cells.
Glue pieces to blocks for sectioning using commercial 5-minute epoxy glue.
